Wincer's Cake House is a charming bakery website that showcases a delightful array of cakes and pastries. With a warm and inviting design, it features an easy-to-navigate menu, online ordering system, and vibrant imagery to entice customers to indulge in their sweet offerings.

This website is a high-fidelity Developer Portfolio designed with a "Cyber-Editorial" aesthetic. It targets a modern, tech-forward audience by blending high-performance engineering vibes with sleek, professional design.
A sleek, high-contrast property management platform designed for the modern rental ecosystem. It bridges the gap between landlords and tenants.
